description: Action items #2 (cross-particle ratio test) + #3 (quantum-dim normalization) from docs/audits/2026-05-24-sm-particle-categorical-map-rt-route.md §9. Tests whether |J_N(T(2,k))| ratios for k ∈ {4, 6, 8} at fixed (N, q_0) match the experimental m_W:m_Z:m_H ratios. Cheap (~3-min compute) cross-validation: matching ratios validates the RT-chain SM identification; mismatching ratios falsify it. Also tests quantum-dim [N]_q vs naive-dim N normalization.
interpretation: Cross-particle ratio test on the RT-chain SM identification. If the W:Z:H assignments to T(2,4):T(2,6):T(2,8) are correct, the |J_N| ratios should match m_W:m_Z:m_H regardless of absolute normalization. Best (N, formula) combination by total deviation reported. Quantum-dim [N]_q normalization tested alongside naive N for the factor-of-2 resolution from Q2 (PR #1116 Higgs probe finding).
